title: PolicyClassifyParams
description: Params for policy.classify: one command line a person typed, and nothing else. There is deliberately no effect here, which is the whole difference from policy.explain's params: that method is about a call that happened and the caller's effect is the fact, while this one is about a command nobody has run, so deriving the effect is the entire point — it is what the person is shown before they widen a permission, and what the resulting rule carries in grantedUnder. A caller that could state the effect here could state anything, and the permit would be typed after all.

command.description: The command line, exactly as the person typed it. The backend parses it with the SAME parser a run uses and NEVER executes it, so what is shown is the reading the enforcement would have.
